title: A soft crossing interpolates to a sharp one inside the knot's graphs
subject: Whether counting on general cubic signed systems reduces to counting on the knot's own, Pfaffian, graphs
conclusion: Repeated k times with capped plumbing, the junction of two twisted truncated-octahedron pages multiplies its four crossing states by 810000, 7506, -22518 and -432 per step, whose prime exponents at 5, 139 and 3 separate them, so interpolation yields an exact crossover inside Pfaffian graphs. Hence counting colourings of every cubic bipartite signed system reduces in polynomial time to counting on cubic bipartite Pfaffian graphs under signings.
